about: Renders a row of controls over a document, a table or a list, with one tab stop for the row. The arrow keys move between the controls. A narrow row folds its actions, its links and its search on its own.

folding.about: The same toolbar at the card's width and at a phone's width. The row measures itself. Narrow, the search folds to a button with its magnifier, and the button opens the field over the whole row. The action with an icon shows the icon alone, the links and the plain actions move into the menu at the end, the primary action keeps its words, and the title in the centre is cut short.
folding.title: Wide and folded for a phone

longTitle: A title long enough to be cut short on a phone, which it is

loose.about: A control outside `Toolbar.Item`, `Toolbar.Action` and `Toolbar.Link` is a tab stop of its own, outside the arrow keys. The light and dark buttons are one such pair.
loose.title: Controls outside the arrow keys

radius.about: Every corner of an outlined row.
radius.title: Corners

size.about: The three sizes. The size sets the gaps, the separator and every button in the row.
size.title: Sizes

title: Toolbar

variant.about: The three looks: plain, outline and surface. An outlined or surface row pads its controls by its own gap.
variant.title: Looks

whole.about: The start band, the centre band and the end band. The row is one tab stop. The arrow keys move between its controls and continue at the other end, and Home and End move to its first and last control. The formatting controls are a group pressed together, and each one is a toggle with `aria-pressed`.
whole.title: Three bands
